summary: Photo-based restoration-view stern, boarding hardware and adjustable motor lift
evidence: Owner-supplied oblique stern overview shows the recessed boarding opening, transverse stainless bar and coil, slatted landing, side rails and lower tread. Close-up shows the raised wooden motor board, paired links and lock plate. Original images remain private.
Owner reports that the bracket lifts and lowers the motor. The raised pose is photographed. The lowered pose and rail function were not independently verified.

measurements.reference: Lowest top edge of the boarding recess relative to nominal model waterline
measurements.method: Fit the opening proportionally at the existing aft station

measurements.reference: Vertical difference between modeled fully lowered and raised board positions
measurements.method: Sweep paired equal-length links about the fixed transom pivots
measurements.confidence: Illustrative travel; no measured end stops or hardware rating
